en: Colorized historic street view showing a gently curving cobbled street lined with two‑ to three‑storey buildings with red-tiled roofs. On the left foreground stands a stone monument or memorial column overgrown with ivy, topped with a pile of cannonballs and bearing a round portrait medallion. A fenced grassy strip with trees runs along the left, while on the right are shops with signage in German. A few pedestrians in long dark clothing and a horse‑drawn vehicle are visible in the distance. The sky is softly tinted blue and yellow. Printed German captions at the top read "Königsbrück." and "Schloßstraße."
